responsibility: This file implements shared HSA support routines and compilation-unit state used across GCC’s HSA generator, dumper, and BRIG emitter. It owns global HSA summaries and symbol maps, per-compilation-unit initialization and teardown, kernel-to-host mapping tables and dependency tracking, helper predicates about HSA callable functions, machine/profile properties, HSA naming and sanitization, and assorted methods on common HSA IL classes such as operand role and internal-function metadata. Its responsibility is the common bookkeeping and utility layer that ties together the HSA subsystem, distinct from lowering, register allocation, dumping, or binary emission.
same_name_distinction: Implements the HSA common interface declared in hsa-common.h: it provides storage for subsystem globals and defines the shared helper routines, compilation-unit lifecycle, summary linking, kernel mapping/dependency bookkeeping, and method bodies for HSA IL support classes, whereas hsa-common.h is the declaration and type-definition layer consumed by the other HSA source files.
